notes: Fixes the Monthly Knowledge Check screen flickering on mobile by removing the self-triggering whole-DOM MutationObserver. Knowledge cards now refresh only on startup, navigation and app resume. Monthly questions still open in the standard Safety Tracker modal after the user taps the knowledge-check button; the modal is forced to start at the top on mobile. Existing automatic question-bank generation, ON/OFF, 1-10 question setting and Easy/Standard/Hard/Mixed difficulty remain unchanged. No SQL migration required.
